package com.m3.collections;

import java.util.AbstractList;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.BitSet;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.RandomAccess;
import java.util.function.Predicate;

/**
 * M3-owned indexed multivalue backend; NOT an implementation of Guava Multimap,
 * Eclipse MutableListMultimap, Spring MultiValueMap or Apache MultiValuedMap.
 * Those libraries have different null, view, mutation and entry-count contracts.
 *
 * <p>One reference-value lane, one primitive next-offset lane and one byte state
 * lane own occurrences. An existing M3LinkedHashMap indexes each distinct key to
 * its group head/tail/count offsets. An object reference is not stored in a Node,
 * Cell or Entry per occurrence. The key index may box one group ID per distinct
 * key; no claim of universal zero-allocation or substitute provider semantics.
 * Removed slots are recycled and cleared for GC. This owner is single-threaded.
 *
 * <p>Returned snapshots copy the referenced values once; thereafter filtered,
 * sorted, sliced and indexed views manipulate index arrays/BitSet facts without
 * reading a mutable parent or re-evaluating a preceding predicate. Native mask
 * selection reuses the existing M3IndexMaskCompactor ABI. No Java object,
 * comparator or callback crosses JNI.
 */
public final class M3IndexedMultiValueMap<K, V> {
    /** Internal presence bit: application masks are restricted to bits 1..7. */
    public static final int LIVE = 0x01;
    public static final int VISIBLE = 0x02;
    public static final int DIRTY = 0x04;
    public static final int DEFERRED = 0x08;

    private final M3LinkedHashMap<K, Integer> groupIds = new M3LinkedHashMap<>();
    private int[] heads = new int[0], tails = new int[0], counts = new int[0];
    private int groupsUsed, freeGroup = -1;
    private Object[] values = new Object[0];
    private int[] next = new int[0];
    private byte[] states = new byte[0];
    private int slotsUsed, freeSlot = -1, size;
    private long revision;

    /** Creates a single-threaded array/index owner with lazy payload allocation. */
    public M3IndexedMultiValueMap() { }

    /** The same key may own multiple equal or null values, each as an occurrence. */
    public void add(K key, V value) { add(key, value, 0); }

    /** Initial caller-defined flags exclude the reserved LIVE bit. */
    public void add(K key, V value, int initialFlags) {
        checkUserBits(initialFlags);
        if (size == Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8) throw new OutOfMemoryError("M3 multivalue capacity");
        Integer existing = groupIds.get(key);
        int group;
        if (existing == null) {
            group = freeGroup >= 0 ? freeGroup : groupsUsed;
            ensureGroupCapacity(group + 1);
            // Preflight the fallible value allocation before publishing a new group.
            if (freeSlot < 0) ensureValueCapacity(slotsUsed + 1);
            groupIds.put(key, group);
            if (freeGroup >= 0) freeGroup = heads[group];
            else groupsUsed++;
            heads[group] = -1;
            tails[group] = -1;
            counts[group] = 0;
        } else {
            group = existing;
            if (freeSlot < 0) ensureValueCapacity(slotsUsed + 1);
        }
        int slot;
        if (freeSlot >= 0) {
            slot = freeSlot;
            freeSlot = next[slot];
        } else slot = slotsUsed++;
        values[slot] = value;
        states[slot] = (byte) (initialFlags | LIVE);
        next[slot] = -1;
        if (tails[group] < 0) heads[group] = slot;
        else next[tails[group]] = slot;
        tails[group] = slot;
        counts[group]++;
        size++;
        revision++;
    }

    /** Total number of value *occurrences*, as in a flattened multimap. */
    public int size() { return size; }
    /** Number of distinct keys (not total occurrences). */
    public int keyCount() { return groupIds.size(); }
    public boolean containsKey(Object key) { return groupIds.containsKey(key); }
    public long revision() { return revision; }
    public int capacity() { return values.length; }

    /** Returns first value, including null; use containsKey to distinguish absent. */
    public V getFirst(Object key) {
        Integer group = groupIds.get(key);
        return group == null ? null : value(heads[group]);
    }

    /** Number of occurrences associated with a key, not counting hidden states. */
    public int valueCount(Object key) {
        Integer group = groupIds.get(key);
        return group == null ? 0 : counts[group];
    }

    /** Detached keys in group-insertion order; null keys are supported. */
    public List<K> keysSnapshot() {
        ArrayList<K> result = new ArrayList<>(groupIds.size());
        for (K key : groupIds.keySet()) result.add(key);
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(result);
    }

    /** Read an occurrence's unsigned state flags, in [0,255]. */
    public int stateAt(Object key, int ordinal) {
        return states[slotAt(key, ordinal)] & 0xff;
    }

    /** Update caller bits without changing internal occupancy or stable order. */
    public int updateState(Object key, int ordinal, int setBits, int clearBits) {
        checkUserBits(setBits);
        checkUserBits(clearBits);
        if ((setBits & clearBits) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("overlapping flags");
        int slot = slotAt(key, ordinal);
        int old = states[slot] & 0xff;
        int updated = (old | setBits) & ~clearBits;
        if (updated != old) {
            states[slot] = (byte) updated;
            revision++;
        }
        return old;
    }

    /** Removal clears GC-visible values and recycles group and occurrence slots. */
    public int removeKey(Object key) {
        Integer group = groupIds.remove(key);
        if (group == null) return 0;
        int removed = counts[group];
        int slot = heads[group];
        while (slot >= 0) {
            int successor = next[slot];
            values[slot] = null;
            states[slot] = 0;
            next[slot] = freeSlot;
            freeSlot = slot;
            slot = successor;
        }
        size -= removed;
        tails[group] = -1;
        counts[group] = 0;
        heads[group] = freeGroup;
        freeGroup = group;
        revision++;
        return removed;
    }

    public void clear() {
        if (groupsUsed == 0 && size == 0) return;
        Arrays.fill(values, 0, slotsUsed, null);
        Arrays.fill(states, 0, slotsUsed, (byte) 0);
        Arrays.fill(next, 0, slotsUsed, 0);
        Arrays.fill(heads, 0, groupsUsed, 0);
        Arrays.fill(tails, 0, groupsUsed, 0);
        Arrays.fill(counts, 0, groupsUsed, 0);
        groupIds.clear();
        slotsUsed = 0;
        groupsUsed = 0;
        freeSlot = -1;
        freeGroup = -1;
        size = 0;
        revision++;
    }

    /** One detached immutable per-key occurrence snapshot; permits nulls. */
    public ValuesSnapshot<V> snapshot(Object key) {
        Integer group = groupIds.get(key);
        int count = group == null ? 0 : counts[group];
        Object[] copied = new Object[count];
        int cursor = group == null ? -1 : heads[group];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (cursor < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("group chain shorter than count");
            copied[i] = values[cursor];
            cursor = next[cursor];
        }
        if (cursor != -1) throw new IllegalStateException("group chain longer than count");
        return ValuesSnapshot.capture(copied);
    }

    /**
     * One native/Java primitive index-selection step for precomputed state bits.
     * The returned snapshot is detached from all slot reuse and future writes.
     */
    public ValuesSnapshot<V> selected(Object key, int required, int forbidden,
            M3IndexMaskCompactor.Backend backend) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(backend, "backend");
        checkMask(required);
        checkMask(forbidden);
        if ((required & forbidden) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("conflicting state masks");
        Integer group = groupIds.get(key);
        int count = group == null ? 0 : counts[group];
        Object[] copied = new Object[count];
        byte[] eligible = new byte[count];
        int[] ordinals = new int[count];
        int cursor = group == null ? -1 : heads[group];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            copied[i] = values[cursor];
            int flags = states[cursor] & 0xff;
            if ((flags & required) == required && (flags & forbidden) == 0) eligible[i] = 1;
            ordinals[i] = i;
            cursor = next[cursor];
        }
        int[] selected = M3IndexMaskCompactor.select(ordinals, eligible, 1, backend);
        return new ValuesSnapshot<>(copied, selected, 0, selected.length);
    }

    private int slotAt(Object key, int ordinal) {
        Integer group = groupIds.get(key);
        int count = group == null ? 0 : counts[group];
        Objects.checkIndex(ordinal, count);
        int slot = heads[group];
        for (int i = 0; i < ordinal; i++) slot = next[slot];
        return slot;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private V value(int slot) { return (V) values[slot]; }

    private static void checkMask(int mask) {
        if ((mask & ~0xff) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("state mask is not a byte");
    }
    private static void checkUserBits(int bits) {
        checkMask(bits);
        if ((bits & LIVE) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("LIVE is allocator-owned");
    }
    private static int grow(int old, int required) {
        if (required < 0 || required > Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8) {
            throw new OutOfMemoryError("M3 indexed multivalue capacity");
        }
        long expanded = Math.max(required, Math.max(8L, (long) old + (old >>> 1) + 1));
        return (int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8L, expanded);
    }
    private void ensureGroupCapacity(int needed) {
        if (needed <= heads.length) return;
        int n = grow(heads.length, needed);
        int[] newHeads = Arrays.copyOf(heads, n);
        int[] newTails = Arrays.copyOf(tails, n);
        int[] newCounts = Arrays.copyOf(counts, n);
        heads = newHeads; tails = newTails; counts = newCounts;
    }
    private void ensureValueCapacity(int needed) {
        if (needed <= values.length) return;
        int n = grow(values.length, needed);
        Object[] newValues = Arrays.copyOf(values, n);
        int[] newNext = Arrays.copyOf(next, n);
        byte[] newStates = Arrays.copyOf(states, n);
        values = newValues; next = newNext; states = newStates;
    }

    /**
     * Immutable indexed snapshot. Filtering and sorting replace only metadata.
     * A Snapshot is not a live values() view or a provider-specific List contract.
     */
    public static final class ValuesSnapshot<E> extends AbstractList<E> implements RandomAccess {
        private final Object[] values;
        private final int[] indices;
        private final int from, to;
        private ValuesSnapshot(Object[] values, int[] indices, int from, int to) {
            this.values = values; this.indices = indices; this.from = from; this.to = to;
        }
        private static <E> ValuesSnapshot<E> capture(Object[] values) {
            int[] indexes = new int[values.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < indexes.length; i++) indexes[i] = i;
            return new ValuesSnapshot<>(values, indexes, 0, values.length);
        }
        @Override public int size() { return to - from; }
        @Override @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") public E get(int ordinal) {
            return (E) values[indices[from + Objects.checkIndex(ordinal, size())]];
        }
        /** Physical position within the detached snapshot, not a live owner slot. */
        public int sourceIndex(int ordinal) {
            return indices[from + Objects.checkIndex(ordinal, size())];
        }
        /** Zero-copy half-open subview of immutable snapshot and index array. */
        @Override public ValuesSnapshot<E> subList(int start, int end) {
            Objects.checkFromToIndex(start, end, size());
            return new ValuesSnapshot<>(values, indices, from + start, from + end);
        }
        /** Selected physical snapshot-position bits, bounded by actual value count. */
        public BitSet positions() {
            BitSet bits = new BitSet();
            for (int i = from; i < to; i++) bits.set(indices[i]);
            return bits;
        }
        /** Evaluate this predicate only once per currently selected occurrence. */
        public ValuesSnapshot<E> filtered(Predicate<? super E> predicate) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(predicate, "predicate");
            int[] selected = new int[size()];
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = from; i < to; i++) {
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") E item = (E) values[indices[i]];
                if (predicate.test(item)) selected[count++] = indices[i];
            }
            return new ValuesSnapshot<>(values, Arrays.copyOf(selected, count), 0, count);
        }
        /** Stable index-only comparator sort; null comparator means natural order. */
        public ValuesSnapshot<E> sorted(Comparator<? super E> comparator) {
            int[] chosen = Arrays.copyOfRange(indices, from, to);
            int n = chosen.length;
            if (n < 2) return new ValuesSnapshot<>(values, chosen, 0, n);
            int[] scratch = new int[n];
            for (long width = 1; width < n; width <<= 1) {
                for (long base = 0; base < n; base += width * 2) {
                    int a = (int) base, mid = (int) Math.min(n, base + width);
                    int end = (int) Math.min(n, base + 2 * width);
                    int b = mid, write = a;
                    while (a < mid && b < end) {
                        E left = element(chosen[a]);
                        E right = element(chosen[b]);
                        if (compare(left, right, comparator) <= 0) scratch[write++] = chosen[a++];
                        else scratch[write++] = chosen[b++];
                    }
                    while (a < mid) scratch[write++] = chosen[a++];
                    while (b < end) scratch[write++] = chosen[b++];
                }
                int[] swap = chosen; chosen = scratch; scratch = swap;
            }
            return new ValuesSnapshot<>(values, chosen, 0, n);
        }
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") private E element(int position) {
            return (E) values[position];
        }
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") private static <E> int compare(
                E left, E right, Comparator<? super E> comparator) {
            return comparator != null ? comparator.compare(left, right)
                    : ((Comparable<? super E>) left).compareTo(right);
        }
        @Override public Object[] toArray() {
            Object[] result = new Object[size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) result[i] = get(i);
            return result;
        }
    }
}
